rubric_items.reason: The design uses only modules and layers that already exist: PatientRepo, PatientService, patientsRouter, PatientsPage, client.ts and the existing index. It adds no new infrastructure and no migration.

The story map covers S-1 to S-4. One gap remains: startsAt shows a date and a time, but REQ-2 asks for the date. REQ-14 asks for the same format as Next appointment, so the conflict is still unresolved.
Method, path and envelope are precise. The field name is still open (Q-01, with a default). The field is described as null in one place and optional in another, so its type is not pinned down.
Known, assumed and unknown are split clearly, and most claims are cited. The index-coverage statement still has no citation, and C12 still says more than its cited fact supports.
All four non-obvious choices are explained. The web-formatting trade-off now points to impact Q-01 correctly and records that its default was adopted.
Clear and short. One inconsistency remains: the field is called null in the overview and optional in the client type.
